description: Source file for a Qwik-based frontend route component that handles editing a note identified by an 'id' parameter. It manages fetching the note from local state, handles not-found cases, and renders a NoteEditor component for editing, along with page metadata.

methods.name: onGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests for the route; in this case, it performs no server-side data fetching, as data is client-side only.
